us-ny-course.basis: Advertised prices of DMV-approved 5-hour pre-licensing course providers (live Zoom/online/classroom): e.g. $40 (coreway.nyc), $43.95 (Safety Sense Solutions), $49 (NYDriver.com), $50 (Drive Rite, Bell's). NY DMV sets no fee, cap or range (checked its course page). No consumer-authority survey found.

us-ct-course.basis: Advertised prices at CT commercial driving schools: $125 (Frank's), $130 (Tom's), $149 (The Next Street), $125 cash/$150 online (Rae's); outlier $200 (Santo). CT DMV page states no fee or cap. No consumer-authority survey found.

ie-edt-lesson.basis: Per lesson, derived from Money Guide Ireland's sample survey of 12-lesson EDT prices around Ireland: range EUR 500-750 for 12, common price ~EUR 550 (=~EUR 46/lesson; range ~42-63). Independent consumer-finance site, not RSA; RSA publishes no price guidance (rsa.ie returned 403 but RSA does not regulate ADI fees).

fr-total.basis: UFC-Que Choisir survey of 1,076 (some reports say 1,374) auto-écoles: average total = basic package EUR ~1,155-1,234 (code, 20 h driving, fees) + 15 extra hours at EUR 43/h, i.e. ~35 hours average for a beginner (legal minimum 20). Range by department EUR ~1,468-1,484 (Nord) to 2,140 (Paris). This is still the most-cited consumer-body figure in 2026 but the study itself dates from 2016; no newer official (Sécurité routière/government) average cost found.
fr-total.source: UFC-Que Choisir study as reported by https://www.digischool.fr/articles/auto/permis-conduire/tarifs-en-auto-ecole/ and https://www.sudradio.fr/on-parle-auto/prix-permis-de-conduire-2026-aides

jp-school.basis: AT-limited: Statistics Bureau Retail Price Survey (小売物価統計調査) item 9325 自動車教習料, 公安委員会指定自動車教習所・第一種普通免許(AT限定), June 2026 value (Jan 2026 320,998; Mar 320,812; Jun 323,488), as tabulated by price.w3g.jp. Geographic scope (likely 東京都区部) not confirmed. MT: no official average; driving-school industry estimate AT ~JPY 280,000-350,000, MT ~JPY 300,000-380,000.
jp-school.source: https://price.w3g.jp/driving-school (data: 総務省統計局 小売物価統計調査)

is-total.basis: Driving-instructor price lists: lesson 45 min ISK 16,500 (normally 17,500), minimum 15 lessons = ISK 247,500; Ökuskóli 1 & 2 ISK 27,000 combined (other schools 9,800-13,500 each); Ökuskóli 3 (skid/risk course) ISK 53,900; total 'at least ISK 375,000' (aksturogkennsla.is) vs 'about ISK 335,000-350,000' (another instructor site). Instructor sites, not an official or consumer survey.

br-lesson-hour.basis: Per practical lesson in São Paulo with a credentialed autonomous instructor under the new CNH rules (minimum 2 practical lessons); another survey puts SP market at R$70-150/hour. Detran-SP publishes no lesson price ('consultar valores junto à Autoescola ou Instrutor'). Official Detran-SP fees for context: medical R$90, psychological R$90, theory exam R$52.83, practical exam R$52.83, CNH issue R$137.79.

br-toxicology.basis: Average standard (7-10 business day) price at accredited labs in São Paulo; express R$220-280. Another guide lists R$160; lab ads from R$95-99.99. Mandatory for first licence processes opened after 2026-06-17 per SP services portal. Detran-SP sets no price.

schoolCourse.note: total B budget incl. state fees; school part: theory 125-250 + 20+ lessons 280-420 + extras 0-300

lv-fees.basis: CSDD tariffs. csdd.lv payments page refused connection, so figures are secondary: theory exam EUR 11.40 is consistent across sources. Driving exam: Baltic Course (from March 2026 tariff) says EUR 35.82 excluding vehicle rental; steerclear says EUR 50.57 (possibly including CSDD car). Licence issue: steerclear/others EUR 22.41; Baltic Course lists EUR 5.42 (EU resident) — conflicting.

mx-cmx-roadtest.basis: SEMOVI published guidelines on Mon 21 Sept 2026 requiring theory and practical exams, but did not state the mandatory start date or any fee for the practical test. So: not confirmed in force; fee unknown. Existing fees for context: Type A licence first issue MXN 1,142 (3 years); permanent licence MXN 1,500.

de-total.basis: ADAC does not publish a single average; it gives two worked examples: all low values + pass first time after 15 practice hours = ~EUR 2,500 (2,466); all high values + 25 practice hours = ~EUR 4,500 (4,476). Practice hour cited elsewhere at EUR 60-100. Press figures of a ~EUR 3,400-4,200 'ADAC average' were not found on the ADAC page.

es-total.basis: OCU survey of 321 driving schools in 25 cities; reference student = 20 practical lessons + one repeated exam; cheapest A Coruña EUR 558, dearest San Sebastián EUR 1,575. OCU gives no single national average. Study is from June 2015. Non-consumer 2026 estimates put the average at EUR 1,000-1,400. DGT exam fee (tasa) not included/checked.

uncertain: us-ny-course and us-ct-course: no official or consumer-authority figure exists; ranges are advertised provider prices.
ie-edt-lesson: per-lesson value is derived (EUR 550 / 12) from an informal consumer-site sample, not RSA.
fr-total: UFC-Que Choisir figure dates from 2016; no newer official average found.
jp-school: AT figure's geographic scope (national vs Tokyo wards) unconfirmed; retrieved via a third-party tabulation of the Retail Price Survey; no official MT average.
is-total: only instructor price lists; totals differ (335k-350k vs 375k+ ISK).
lv-fees: CSDD site unreachable; driving exam (35.82 vs 50.57) and licence issue (22.41 vs 5.42) conflict between secondary sources.
mx-cmx-roadtest: start date and fee not published; treated as not yet in force.
de-total: ADAC gives a range from worked examples, not an average; dated April 2025.
es-total: OCU study dates from 2015 and gives a city range, not a national average.
br-lesson-hour, br-toxicology: commercial/blog surveys only; no official price.
